package handler

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/dynamodb"
)

// scenario for dynamodb_scan_in_handler: `dynamodb.Scan` in request handler functions
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: warning.
func ScanProductsHandler(ddb *dynamodb.Client, tableName string) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		category := r.URL.Query().Get("category")

		input := &dynamodb.ScanInput{
			TableName:        &tableName,
			FilterExpression: stringPtr("category = :cat"),
			ExpressionAttributeValues: map[string]dynamodb.AttributeValue{
				":cat": {S: &category},
			},
		}
		output, err := ddb.Scan(context.Background(), input)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "scan failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
		for _, item := range output.Items {
			w.Write([]byte(*item["id"].S + "\n"))
		}
	}
}

func stringPtr(s string) *string {
	return &s
}
